files.Summary: Live counters of the running server, for the dashboard.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.AccessTokenRow
files.Summary: An access token, stored as its SHA-256 hash so a leaked database does not leak sessions.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.AccountDataRow
files.Summary: Account data of a user: global when is empty, else for one room.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.CounterRow

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DataDirectoryLock
files.Summary: Keeps other server processes off a data directory while this one uses it: is held open exclusively, which on Linux is an flock that the kernel releases when the process ends, also when it is killed, so the lock never goes stale.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DatabaseMigrator
files.Summary: Creates or upgrades the schema at start, before the server accepts requests, in write-ahead log mode so reads do not block writes; and flushes the database at stop.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DelayedEventRow
files.Summary: A delayed event (MSC4140) waiting to be sent, kept so that a restart of the server does not forget it.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DesignTimeServerDbContextFactory
files.Summary: Context for dotnet ef at design time, on a throwaway SQLite file.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DeviceKeysRow
files.Summary: The signed device keys of a device, without signatures others uploaded later.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DeviceListChangeRow
files.Summary: The latest change of a user's devices or cross-signing keys, which others' syncs report in device_lists.changed.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.DeviceRow
files.Summary: A device of a local user.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.EventEdgeRow
files.Summary: Edge of the room graph: an event and one of its previous events.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.EventRelationRow
files.Summary: A relation of an event to another, from its m.relates_to, for threads and relation lookups.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.EventRow
files.Summary: An event of the room graph, stored as its PDU JSON without the event ID.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.FallbackKeyRow
files.Summary: The fallback key of a device for one algorithm, given out when its one-time keys run out.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.FederationOutboxRow
files.Summary: A PDU or EDU waiting to be sent to another server, kept so a restart does not lose it; deleted once sent or refused for good.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.FederationProgressRow
files.Summary: How far the federation sender has handed the stream to its queue, so a restart continues there and misses nothing; one row.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.FilterRow
files.Summary: A stored sync filter of a user.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ForgottenRoomRow
files.Summary: A room a user has forgotten, so it no longer shows in their sync.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ForwardExtremityRow
files.Summary: A forward extremity: an event of the room that no other event follows yet; new events point at these.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.KeyBackupVersionRow
files.Summary: A key backup version of a user.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.KeySignatureRow
files.Summary: A signature uploaded later for a device key or a master key, kept apart so each user sees only the signatures meant for them.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.MediaRow
files.Summary: A file in the media repository, uploaded by a local user; the bytes are stored in the media directory.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.PusherRow
files.Summary: A pusher: where to send push notifications of a user, usually a push gateway that wakes a phone app.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ReceiptRow
files.Summary: A user's latest receipt of one type and thread in a room.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.RegistrationTokenRow
files.Summary: A registration token an admin created, as Synapse's admin API manages them.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.RemoteInviteRow
files.Summary: An invite from another server to a room not on this server yet, with the room's stripped state; joining the room or rejecting the invite ends it.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.RemoteMediaRow
files.Summary: Media of another server, fetched once and kept here; its file and thumbnails are stored under , an ID of this server, as other servers' IDs are not safe as paths.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ReportRow
files.Summary: A user's report of an event, room or user, for the admin to review.

files.Summary: A backed-up room key of one session.

files.Summary: A room known to the server.

files.Summary: The homeserver's database; SQLite now, PostgreSQL later through the same model.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ServerKeyResponseRow
files.Summary: Another server's signed key answer, as /_matrix/key/v2/server gave it, kept so a restart or a server that is down does not stop checking its signatures; the latest per server.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.StateGroupEntryRow
files.Summary: One state entry of a state group.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.StateGroupRow
files.Summary: A room state snapshot, stored as changes against a parent group.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ThumbnailRow
files.Summary: A generated thumbnail of a , stored next to it.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.ToDeviceRow
files.Summary: A to-device message waiting for its device's next sync.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.TransactionRow
files.Summary: A client transaction ID mapped to the event it created, so retried sends are not duplicated.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Storage.UserRow
files.Summary: A local user account.

files.Summary: The server's single stream of persistent changes: each write takes the next position, which sync tokens count.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Sync.SlidingSyncService
files.Summary: Simplified sliding sync (MSC4186), which Element X and other new clients need: room lists in windows ordered by activity, room subscriptions, and extensions for to-device messages, encryption, account data, receipts and typing.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Sync.SyncFilter
files.Summary: The parts of a sync filter the server applies.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Server.Sync.SyncService
files.Summary: Sync, room history and event context for local users.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Video.IVideoDecoder
files.Summary: Decodes a stream's frames, one at a time, in order: in C#, or a platform's, e.g. Android's hardware decoder.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Video.VideoFrame
files.Summary: A decoded picture in I420: full-size luma, and both chroma planes at half the width and height, rounded up; each plane tightly packed.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Video.Vp8.Vp8Decoder
files.Summary: Decodes VP8 frames, RFC 6386, in pure C#: a port of the RFC's reference decoder, exact to libvpx, so that its test vectors decode bit for bit.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.Video.Vp8.Vp8Encoder
files.Summary: Encodes pictures as VP8 frames, RFC 6386, in pure C#: keyframes, every macroblock predicted from its edges by DC, and inter frames between them, every macroblock predicted from the previous picture at the same place and skipped when nothing is left to code; one quantizer, the default probabilities and no loop filter.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.AudioPeerConnection
files.Summary: A WebRTC peer connection with one Opus audio stream each way, as 1:1 voice calls use: SDP offer and answer, ICE with trickled candidates, DTLS-SRTP, and RTP; and, when the peer offers it and is set, VP8 video received.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Dtls.DtlsCertificate
files.Summary: A self-signed ECDSA P-256 certificate for DTLS-SRTP; WebRTC trusts it by the fingerprint that the signalled SDP carries, not by any authority.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Dtls.DtlsSrtp
files.Summary: DTLS-SRTP over a datagram path, e.g. an ICE pair: a DTLS 1.2 handshake with BouncyCastle that checks the peer's certificate against its signalled fingerprint, and yields the SRTP sessions of both directions.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.IMediaConnection
files.Summary: The media of a call, as its voice and video pipelines see it: Opus frames and VP8 frames each way, with the feedback of the video; a to the peer, or the connections of an SFU call together.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Ice.IceAgent
files.Summary: A full ICE agent for one component over UDP, IPv4 and IPv6, as WebRTC's bundled, RTCP-multiplexed media needs: gathers candidates, checks pairs with the peer, selects one, and carries datagrams over it.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Ice.IceCandidate
files.Summary: An ICE candidate over UDP: where a peer may be reached, written as the candidate attribute of SDP.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Ice.IceCandidateType
files.Summary: The type of an ICE candidate, which ranks it: direct beats reflexive beats relayed.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Ice.IceOptions
files.Summary: Options of an .

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Ice.IceServer
files.Summary: A STUN or TURN server, as Matrix's /voip/turnServer lists them.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Ice.IceState
files.Summary: The state of an .

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.PeerConnectionOptions
files.Summary: Options of an .

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.PeerConnectionState
files.Summary: The state of an .

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.BandwidthEstimator
files.Summary: Estimates the bitrate a received stream may have from its loss, report by report, as loss-based congestion control does: down by a part when much is lost, up slowly while little is.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.JitterBuffer
files.Summary: Puts received RTP packets back in order and evens out their arrival, for a player that takes one frame every packet interval: it holds a few packets before the first one plays, and then gives the next in sequence, or null so that the decoder conceals a frame.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.ReceiverStatistics
files.Summary: Counts how one RTP stream arrives, for its reception report, as RFC 3550 appendix A does: the highest sequence number with wraparounds, packets lost, interarrival jitter, and the last sender report.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.ReportBlock
files.Summary: A reception report block of RFC 3550 6.4.1: how a stream arrives.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.Rtcp
files.Summary: Builds and reads the RTCP packets a video receiver needs: a compound of a receiver report, RFC 3550 6.4.2, and the sender's CNAME, with a picture loss indication, RFC 4585 6.3.1, when a keyframe is needed; and the time of sender reports, for the reports' round-trip fields.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.RtpPacket
files.Summary: An RTP packet: the fixed header, header extensions of the one-byte form, and the payload; CSRCs are skipped when parsed.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.Vp8Depacketizer
files.Summary: Puts VP8 frames together from RTP packets, RFC 7741: the packets of a frame share a timestamp, the first starts partition 0, and the last has the marker bit. Packets may come out of order; frames are given in order.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.Vp8EncodedFrame
files.Summary: A VP8 frame put together from RTP packets: its RTP timestamp, whether it is a keyframe, and the frame as the decoder takes it.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Rtp.Vp8Packetizer
files.Summary: Splits VP8 frames into RTP payloads, RFC 7741: each starts with a payload descriptor carrying a 15-bit picture ID, which receivers use to notice lost frames; the first of a frame has the start bit.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.AudioSdp
files.Summary: Offers and answers of one Opus audio stream over WebRTC: bundled, with RTCP multiplexed, ICE credentials, DTLS-SRTP, and trickled candidates. An offer's VP8 video may be accepted for receiving, sending or both; other media are rejected in the answer.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.LocalAudio
files.Summary: What this side puts in its offer or answer.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.MediaDescription
files.Summary: A media section of an SDP: its m= line and the attributes under it.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.RemoteAudio
files.Summary: What the peer's offer or answer says of its audio.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.RemoteTransport
files.Summary: What the peer's offer or answer says of its transport, which all bundled sections share.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.RemoteVideo
files.Summary: What the peer's offer or answer says of its video.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Sdp.SessionDescription
files.Summary: An SDP session description, as offers and answers carry it: the session's lines and attributes, then the media sections.

files.Title: Uniform.Matrix.WebRtc.Srtp.SrtpSession
files.Summary: One direction of SRTP and SRTCP with the AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80 suite, which WebRTC requires: protects outgoing packets, or checks and decrypts incoming ones.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.DatagramSender
files.Summary: Sends a datagram to an address, e.g. through the UDP socket a call uses.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Hosting.PemCertificate
files.Summary: A TLS certificate from PEM files, read again when either file changes, so renewals need no restart.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Hosting.TurnHostingExtensions
files.Summary: Adds the STUN and TURN server to a .NET host.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Hosting.TurnOptions
files.Summary: Settings of the STUN and TURN server in section Turn, e.g. --Turn:Enabled=true --Turn:ExternalAddress=203.0.113.5; every change takes effect after a restart, as the server binds its ports at start.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Hosting.TurnServerHost
files.Summary: Runs a in a .NET host when is set, with the credentials of the settings and of every registered in the host, e.g. a homeserver's own secret.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.ChannelData
files.Summary: TURN channel data: a channel number, a length, and the data, with four bytes of overhead instead of a Send or Data indication's thirty-six.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunAddress
files.Summary: The address attributes of STUN: XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS and the like, whose port and address are XOR'ed with the magic cookie and, for IPv6, the transaction ID, so that middleboxes do not rewrite them.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunAttribute
files.Summary: A STUN attribute: its type and value.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunAttributeTypes
files.Summary: Attribute types of STUN, TURN and ICE.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunClass
files.Summary: The class of a STUN message.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunErrorCodes
files.Summary: Error codes of STUN and TURN, with their reason phrases in .

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunMessage
files.Summary: A STUN message: method, class, transaction ID and attributes, parsed from or encoded to the wire with optional MESSAGE-INTEGRITY and FINGERPRINT.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.StunMethod
files.Summary: The method of a STUN message: STUN's Binding, and the TURN methods.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.Protocol.TurnCredentials
files.Summary: Time-limited TURN credentials from a secret shared by a TURN server and the service that hands them out, such as a Matrix homeserver's /voip/turnServer: the user name is expiry:name, with the expiry in Unix seconds, and the password is the Base64 HMAC-SHA1 of the user name with the secret.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.StunClient
files.Summary: STUN transactions over a datagram socket someone else reads: sends requests, retransmits them as RFC 8489 6.2.1 says, and completes them with the responses fed to .

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.StunDiscovery
files.Summary: Finds the public address of this computer, as a STUN server sees it: e.g. the router's address behind NAT.

files.Title: Uniform.Stun.TurnClient
files.Summary: A TURN client over UDP: allocates a relayed address on a TURN server, permits peers, and relays datagrams to and from them, refreshing all until closed.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.CombinedAuthenticator
files.Summary: Tries several authenticators in order, e.g. shared secrets and fixed users together.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.ITurnAuthenticator
files.Summary: Finds the keys of a user's long-term credentials, which the TURN server checks requests with.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.IpRange
files.Summary: A range of IP addresses in CIDR notation, such as 10.0.0.0/8 or fe80::/10; a single address is a range of one.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.SharedSecretAuthenticator
files.Summary: Time-limited credentials from shared secrets, as Matrix homeservers hand them out: see . Several secrets let one be replaced without cutting off credentials made with the other.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.StaticUserAuthenticator
files.Summary: Fixed users with passwords, e.g. from settings, for TURN servers without a service that hands out time-limited credentials.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.TurnServer
files.Summary: A STUN and TURN server: answers Binding requests, and relays UDP between authenticated clients and their peers. Clients reach it over UDP, TCP or TLS; peers over UDP.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.TurnServerOptions
files.Summary: Settings of a : where it listens, which relay ports and address it uses, how long allocations last, and the limits that keep it from becoming an open relay.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.TurnServerStatus
files.Summary: What a is doing.

files.Title: Uniform.Turn.TurnTransport
files.Summary: How a client reaches the TURN server; the relay towards peers is always UDP.
